title: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December
question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.

prediction.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
base AS (
  SELECT p.id AS product_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS start_inv,
         pm.qty_minimum,
         pm.qty_purchase
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN product_minimums pm ON pm.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, pm.qty_minimum, pm.qty_purchase
),
rec(product_id, mth, end_inv, qty_minimum, qty_purchase) AS (
  SELECT b.product_id,
         '2019-01-01',
         CASE
           WHEN b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0) < b.qty_minimum
           THEN b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0) + b.qty_purchase
           ELSE b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0)
         END,
         b.qty_minimum,
         b.qty_purchase
  FROM base b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month')),
         CASE
           WHEN r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0) < r.qty_minimum
           THEN r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0) + r.qty_purchase
           ELSE r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0)
         END,
         r.qty_minimum,
         r.qty_purchase
  FROM rec r
  WHERE r.mth < '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         ABS(end_inv - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(end_inv - qty_minimum), mth) AS rn
  FROM rec
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
base AS (
  SELECT p.id AS product_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS inv,
         pm.qty_minimum,
         pm.qty_purchase
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.product_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN product_minimums pm ON pm.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, pm.qty_minimum, pm.qty_purchase
),
months(mth) AS (
  SELECT '2019-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(mth, '+1 month')) FROM months WHERE mth < '2019-12-01'
),
rec(product_id, mth, inv, qty_minimum, qty_purchase) AS (
  SELECT b.product_id, '2019-01-01', b.inv, b.qty_minimum, b.qty_purchase
  FROM base b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month')),
         CASE WHEN r.inv < r.qty_minimum
              THEN r.inv + r.qty_purchase - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)
              ELSE r.inv - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)
         END,
         r.qty_minimum,
         r.qty_purchase
  FROM rec r
  LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms
    ON ms.product_id = r.product_id
   AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))
  WHERE r.mth < '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT product_id, mth,
         ABS(inv - qty_minimum) AS diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(inv - qty_minimum), mth) AS rn
  FROM rec
)
SELECT product_id, mth, diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id

              THEN b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0) + b.qty_purchase
              ELSE b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0)
         END

  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id, date(r.mth, '+1 month'),
         CASE WHEN r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = date(r.mth, '+1 month')), 0) < b.qty_minimum

  FROM products p

  LEFT JOIN product_minimums pm ON pm.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, pm.qty_minimum, pm.qty_purchase
),

  SELECT b.product_id,
         '2019-01-01',
         CASE
           WHEN b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0) < b.qty_minimum
           THEN b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0) + b.qty_purchase
           ELSE b.start_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = b.product_id AND ms.mth = '2019-01-01'), 0)
         END,
         b.qty_minimum,
         b.qty_purchase
  FROM base b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month')),
         CASE
           WHEN r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0) < r.qty_minimum
           THEN r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0) + r.qty_purchase
           ELSE r.end_inv - COALESCE((SELECT ms.qty FROM monthly_sales ms WHERE ms.product_id = r.product_id AND ms.mth = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(r.mth, '+1 month'))), 0)
         END,
         r.qty_minimum,
         r.qty_purchase
  FROM rec r
  WHERE r.mth < '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         ABS(end_inv - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(end_inv - qty_minimum), mth) AS rn
  FROM rec
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id
